# Club Choir

> A fun, welcoming community choir with locations across Quebec. No audition required — just show up and sing.

Club Choir is a non-auditioned community choir founded by Ailsa, offering weekly rehearsals at four locations in Quebec: Montreal, Hudson, Saint-Hubert, and Pointe-Claire. We learn by ear, champion progress over perfection, and bring live instrumental accompaniment to every rehearsal.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Club Choir, locations, and how to join.
- [Our Story](/about): About founder Ailsa and the philosophy behind Club Choir.
- [This Week](/this-week): Weekly rehearsal times and venues for all locations.
- [Upcoming Events](/events): Concerts, pop-ups, and special events.
- [Register](/register): Sign up for a session at one of our locations.
- [Try a Session](/try): Drop in for a single rehearsal to see if it's right for you.
- [Bring a Friend](/bring-a-friend): Invite someone to join you at a rehearsal.
- [Corporate Team-Building](/corporate): Singing workshops for companies and teams.
- [Mailing List](/subscribe): Stay in the loop about new sessions and events.
